data.body:
[P2] Account for partition locations before reporting table writes

The repository's `buildCreateTableDdl` enables partition projection with locations under `<root>/year=.../month=.../day=...`. An output location such as `<root>/athena-results/` passes this prefix test but is outside every projected partition, so those files do not become table rows. The new gate nevertheless blocks this safe configuration until the user accepts write access. Base the classification on the table's actual partition locations or projection template, rather than treating every descendant of `StorageDescriptor.Location` as scanned data.
